recommendation.title: 40–50 minutes easy with the group
details: Run at conversational effort, RPE 2–3; roughly 6–8 km.
Stay relaxed on hills and do not add a tempo segment, strides, intervals or a fast finish.
Finish early if effort or heart rate rises unusually for the conditions.
recommendation.alternative: 25–30 minutes of easy walking, or full rest.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Reduce or stop for pain that changes gait, dizziness, unusual fatigue, illness, chest symptoms or other concerning symptoms.
